## Faster video downloads, ffmpeg with Set yt-dlp, downloads that stay out of your way

- **Downloads from the browser show only their own windows.** The File Info, progress and "Download complete" windows come up; NDM's main window stays where it was: in the notification area, minimized, or behind your browser.
- **Downloads -> Set yt-dlp also sets up ffmpeg** (with ffprobe) when there is none yet: the build for your system is downloaded, checked against its published SHA-256, added to PATH and tried once. With ffmpeg, yt-dlp joins video and audio in any format.
- **Video and audio download at the same time**, and the HLS / DASH pieces yt-dlp fetches come over several connections at once (the download's connection count, up to 64) instead of one after another.
- **One stream NDM's engine can't fetch goes to yt-dlp alone**, while the other keeps downloading; **the speed limit covers both streams together**.
- **Any website yt-dlp supports**: the page's right-click menu "Download this video with New Download Manager" is on every site. Audio-only pages and playlist pages (their first video) work too.
- **If video and audio can't be joined**, NDM says so and keeps both files instead of finishing with a video without sound.
- **Stop ends yt-dlp and everything it started** at once.
